newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy new car May registrations seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy new car May registrations seen up.

text.p: Italy new car registrations in May are expected to rise around 40 percent from May 1996 to around 225,000-230,000 as a new car buying incentive scheme continues to boost demand, analysts and industry sources said on Thursday.

The Italian Ministry of Transport is set to release May new car registration data on June 10. This will follow data which showed registrations rising 52.4 percent to 231,500 in April 1997. New car registrations were 162,384 in May 1996.
"I expect a figure in line with April, one also needs to consider that May 1997 had one less working day than May 1996," said analyst Giampaolo Trasi at brokers IMI Sigeco.
Another analyst said he saw a rise of 35-50 percent in May and added that the net rise in registrations in the first part of the year had started to decline from March.
The annual rise in registrations was 87 percent in February from the same month in 1996, and the absolute rise declined to a 54 percent increase in April.

Italy introduced its new car incentive scheme at the start of this year whereby owners of cars of over 10 years old can receive a discount if they trade them in for a new model. The scheme is set to run until the end of September.
